payload.entry: Root causes (product vs test): (1) Open Hint chip was gated on primaryActionEnabled/grammar, hiding it with no preview yet and with legacy previewResults; product now shows the chip whenever hasDraft and the plan is available, still disabling the button until Capture is enabled. (2) Explicit completion splice of replacement "cash" over "Call @ca" range (6,8) yields "Call @cash"; tests waited for "Call cash". Client-replaced case now uses setProcessClient so the new bob re-parses. (3) Template list first row fieldCount is 1 in capture-templates-list-populated.json. Delete record raced optimistic local removal; wait now includes argv=capture-templates delete. Command-S refusal now expects bob copy "add `%t` to the draft's first item to save it as a template". (4) Unselected type menu Tab uses fixture replacement "#build" (no trailing space); Up selects last of the six fixture rows. portable-check on athena: 1898 tests, 0 failures. just docs-check passed. Mac scratch typecheck skipped (mac SSH timed out). macos-ci-check next.

CI 41291891532 SHA dfdd52e: 11 of 12 gone. Remaining of the twelve: testExplicitCompletionSubmitIsCanceledWhenBobClientIsReplaced timed out at :525 because setProcessClient left suppressedCompletionAcceptanceDraft set, so editorTextDidChange returned without re-parsing. NEW: testTwoClipboardChangesSupersedeOlderPreviewsForTheSameDraft got second newest (fake-bob dry-run sequence file race; passed on master 41289488292). f3 seven all still failed. Fixes: clear suppression on client replace; lock dry-run sequence increment; waitUntil requires newest lines. portable-check 1898 ok. Re-running macos-ci-check.

drawer-writes landed: separate #type retypes +id target in same transaction (D8 relocation, one atomic batch); blank-line on drawer creation fixed (header no longer double-newlines, simplified create branch); parent_section replaced by drawer {title,key,created} (null for plain child) with human 'new drawer' + type row; drawer spans carry title/key; refusal codes for invalid_drawer/drawer_text/ambiguous/reserved/near_duplicate/drawer_toggle/R3; drawer_near_catalog warning via capture warnings. Verified: cargo test -p bob-obsidian --test cli 2605 passed, cargo test --lib capture_language 444 passed, just docs-check passed (447), git grep parent_section clean, landing smokes for writes (retype BUILD->FIX, new-drawer bytes without blank line, drawer_text/reserved/near_duplicate/ambiguous codes, warning, toggle code) pass. No Cargo.toml/CHANGELOG edits.

Failed tests are exactly the bob-cli-f3 seven baseline (testToggleLineCaseUndoRestoresOriginalLine, testTaskTypeRetypeMoveKeepsDraftAndUsesEnsureNextAction, testPlusAfterCaretIDSwitchesToSubBulletInOneUndoStep, testPlusToggleUndoRestoresLiteralPostKeyDraftOnce, testTypedPlusAsWholeItemOpensActiveTaskPickerThroughKeyIntent, testBareLeadingTrailingAndChildMarkersOpenTaskTypeMenu, testTypedRowDoesNotWriteVisibility). payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: drawer catalog rewrites its cache file on every rescan — load_drawer_catalog (capture_drawers.rs) starts cache_dirty = true, so each 60 s TTL expiry re-serializes the whole cache even when no note changed (stale-TTL drawer menu ~32 ms vs ~15 ms warm on a 400-note fixture); initialize cache_dirty from whether any per-file entry was rescanned or dropped.

Drawer menu shipped in bob-cli: new capture_complete/drawers.rs builds task / recent / new groups; bob-authored detail ('2 notes', '1 note', 'empty', 'used in 12 notes · 3 days ago') and consequence ('Adds after "2 GB RAM" in REQUIREMENTS', 'Adds to X', 'Creates X under ^bar', '## ' forms on ^prj); refused comes from the same resolve_drawer_for_write/resolve_h2_for_write the commit uses (reserved copy now names the real key, was hardcoded LINKS); replacement is #slug only when the slug round-trips to the same drawer on the full target list, else #"TITLE"; Drawer field replacement now starts at the # and covers quoted literals (closed-literal query decodes without the closing quote); cursor_after; initial_selection none on empty query (drawer query now reported as 'query'); missing/duplicate/non-task target = diagnostic + no rows; ^prj keeps H2 task rows and also gets recent/new. Shell 'task sections' group -> 'drawers' in shell.rs, providers.rs, tests, docs/completion.md; sweep grep leaves only alias registration/test, justfile smoke, mkdocs redirect, decision-record text, grouped_task_sections family and one narrow --task-section negative test. Docs: capture.md, completion.md, json-outputs.md, capture-complete --help; just docs-gen + docs-check pass. Tests: new unit suite capture_complete/tests/drawers.rs, tests/cli/capture/complete_drawers.rs (incl. accept-row-then-dry-run round trip proving menu == commit), language field tests, capture_drawers helper tests; just check passes (fmt, clippy, 4265 lib + 2612 cli tests). Latency (release, 400 notes x 5 tasks x 3 drawers, XDG cache isolated): drawer menu warm 15.3 ms (empty) / 13.7 ms (typed) vs task_type 9.0 ms warm = +6 ms (target <=~20 ms); stale-60s-TTL rescan 31.7 ms; cold (no cache) 105 ms median on that heavier fixture (ey.2 recorded 19.6 cold / 23.7 warm on its fixture, so not directly comparable; old drawer menu never touched the catalog). Wire breaks (for feat(capture)! + BREAKING CHANGE footer): drawer row group 'drawers' -> 'task', replacement/replacement.start now cover the #, drawer row replacement carries leading '#'. Mac phase bob-cli-ey.7.4 should regenerate fixtures from this commit. No Cargo.toml/CHANGELOG edits.
